rules.PTO-001: Employees accrue 1.5 PTO days per month, usable after 90 days.
rules.PTO-002: PTO above 5 consecutive days needs manager approval.
rules.EXP-101: Meal expenses are reimbursed up to Rs 500 per day with receipts.
rules.SEC-201: Customer data exports require security team sign-off.
